title: White Horse Media
description: “Behold,” God predicted in Old Testament times, “I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord.” Malachi 4:5. Watch Steve Wohlberg and David Machado join forces to explore mighty biblical truths about the ancient showdown between Elijah and false prophets, John the Baptist, and God’s end-time Elijahs who warn the world about Satan’s global deceptions and Mystery Babylon before the battle of Armageddon.

title: White Horse Media
description: Debates about the Godhead rage on. What does the Bible really say about the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit? Are they three separate, equal, co-eternal Persons united in one, or only two (the Father and the Son), with the Father being the “true God,” and the Holy Spirit being an invisible manifestation of the Son? In this new 5-part series, Steve Wohlberg and Kim Kjaer tackle this issue head on.
